additions.group: 極小・独立ステレオ視差推定
additions.reason_selected: Adds independently distilled/architecture-searched stereo disparity from rectified paired images; v77 has no identified stereo disparity specialist. Hunyuan3D generates assets, SAM3 segments masks, RoboTracker tracks temporal points; none directly estimates dense metric geometry. Publisher ~14.6M parameters, exact full tensor census unresolved.
additions.quality_positive: CVPR 2026 family paper reports >10x speed vs FoundationStereo with close zero-shot accuracy; independent arXiv:2610.27199 reports Fast-FoundationStereo family 0.33% AbsRel at a higher compute point on Jetson AGX Orin/Middlebury 2014, not verified for this exact commercial BP2 checkpoint.
additions.quality_negative: Authors distinguish faster from more accurate research checkpoints; independent study found classical libSGM competitive (0.73% AbsRel at 25ms at its real-time operating point). Different operating points and exact checkpoint unresolved; no matched owner test, no universal superiority or safety-critical reliability.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Benign offline object/documentation metrology only for research; compare classical SGM and teacher. No autonomous or safety-critical deployment. Native PTH and ONNX exports are alternative representations, not separate training outcomes. Publisher code licenses separate; no unsafe loading.
additions.observed_access: HF API public ungated observed R175; owner licensed acts unverified
additions.license_metadata: NVIDIA Open Model Agreement; fixed card says commercial and noncommercial; earlier indexed card says research/evaluation only. Upstream research-only code vs TAO Apache-2.0; exact act rights unresolved.

parameter_gate.evidence_kind: Publisher approximate count, no independent full tensor census
